value: SELECT FLOOR(3600*100*DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS',165.310414737,-48.6136321333),   POINT('ICRS',ra_img,decl_img))+0.5)/100 AS r_cntr,* FROM dr4.photometry WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra_img,decl_img),   CIRCLE('ICRS',165.310414737,-48.6136321333,0.00694444444444)) ORDER BY r_cntr ASC
